traits.name: Strix Camaraderie
traits.text: Strix kinmates are tightly bonded to one another, adept at teamwork and supporting each other's attacks. If an enemy is within reach of both the kinmate and one other strix, that enemy is flat-footed to all strix.

traits.name: Strix Vengeance
traits.text: ⭓ (emotion, mental); Frequency once per minute Trigger The kinmate or a strix ally they can see is damaged by an enemy's critical hit Effect Until the end of their next turn, the kinmate gains a 1d6 (1d6) status bonus to damage rolls on Strikes they make against the triggering enemy.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +10 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d6+4 (1d6+4) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ shortbow +10 (deadly d10, range increment 60 feet); Damage 1d6+2 (1d6+2) piercing
